The '''I'att family''' owned [[I'att Armament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. Members of the family included [[Strephan I'att]], [[Augusta I'att]], and [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin]].
